title: A typed diagram of the scalar tensor total paths
statement: A typed summand diagram records eight objects: the four vertices of the left total-degree path and its four ordinary summand vertices; their three horizontal maps; four coproduct injections; the right total-degree path and its ordinary path. For finite R, p:X→Y, P,Q and a+b=n, construct this record from degree n of the actual chain diagram, the ordinary scalar tensorators and comparisons, and the native coproduct injections. Its fields assert no compatibility and choose no new data.

proof.text: Take the four objects, three edges and right arrow of the native cochain diagram in degree n. Use the corresponding four ordinary tensor objects, their tensorator and scalar-comparison maps, and the native mapped coproduct injections. Every field is an explicit existing object or map; there are no proof or witness fields.

def finiteScalarTensorSummandDiagram
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)

      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R))) ℤ)
    (a b n : ℤ) (h : a + b = n) :
    FiniteScalarTensorSummandDiagram (proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X R))
